summary: Postinstall DNS exfiltration of host identifiers to attacker-controlled OOB domain
details: The package's postinstall script collects installer host identifiers — os.hostname(), process.cwd(), platform/arch/node version, and the USER/USERNAME environment variable — hex-encodes them, and issues DNS queries whose labels embed that data under *.dc.oob.s4yhii.com. The queries fire automatically on `npm install` with no caller consent or configuration. The version string (999.0.3) and the scope-prefixed name are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure designed to win resolution against an internal package. Installing or resolving this package causes installer host metadata to leak out-of-band via DNS to an attacker-controlled domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
